row: Dr. Alongi Aron shares scientific knowledge about mechanisms of injury and shows how certain specific exercises and stretches can assist you in healing joints and the muscles soft tissues of your body. Her passion is to educate people about the wonders of natural healing methodologies and focuses on improving joint mechanics, reducing and preventing degenerative arthritic conditions, improving circulation to vertebra and extremity tissues and nerves, even if there are no symptoms of pain, dysfunction, or disease. These tips and advice from over 22 years of practice, ten plus years of higher education, thousands of hours of clinical experience and yearly training seminars with colleagues can improve your longevity and wellness, and ability to continue athletic activities as you age.
